records.claim: Birth defects can happen in any pregnancy for different reasons. Out of all babies born each year, about 3 out of 100 (3%) will have a birth defect. We look at research studies to try to understand if an exposure, like famotidine, might increase the chance of birth defects in a pregnancy. Studies on the use of famotidine in pregnancy do not report an increased chance of birth defects.
records.source_section: Does taking famotidine increase the chance of birth defects?
